data.name: Avan
data.gender_notes: Avan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'avang' meaning wind or breath. This name is also associated with the idea of being free and unrestrained. The name Avan carries the meaning “Wind, breath” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian, Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Avan usually hope their child will grow to embody wind, breath and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the breath of life and the freedom to live it as one chooses.
data.etymology: Avan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wind, breath.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avan total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: أوان
in_arabic.long_meaning: أوان هو اسم مشتق من الفعل 'أَوَنَ' الذي يعني الاستعداد أو الوقت المناسب. في اللغة العربية، يرتبط اسم أوان بالوقت المناسب أو اللحظة الصحيحة للقيام بشيء ما. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات في سياق الحديث عن الأوقات والمواقيت، مما يعطي الاسم قيمة دينية وروحانية.

in_urdu.name: اوان
in_urdu.long_meaning: اوان ایک ایسا نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے الفعل 'أَوَنَ' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مناسب وقت یا موقع۔ اردو میں، اوان کا نام وقت کے تصور اور کسی کام کے لئے موزوں لمحے کے انتخاب سے وابستہ ہے۔ اسلامی تقالید میں، وقت کی مناسبیت اور اس کا حسن استعمال بہت اہم ہے، جس کی وجہ سے یہ نام روحانی اہمیت کا حامل ہے۔

in_hindi.name: आवन
in_hindi.long_meaning: आवन नाम की उत्पत्ति 'أَوَنَ' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है उचित समय या अवसर। हिंदी में, आवन नाम समय की अवधारणा और किसी कार्य के लिए सही क्षण चुनने से जुड़ा है। भारतीय मुस्लिम परंपरा में, समय की सार्थकता और इसके अच्छे उपयोग पर बहुत जोर दिया जाता है, जिससे यह नाम आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: اوان
in_pashto.long_meaning: اوان د 'أَوَنَ' څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی، چې مطلب یې د وخت مناسب یا موقع دی. په پښتو کې، اوان نوم د وخت مفهوم او د کوم کار لپاره د سمې شېبې ټاکلو سره تړلی دی. په افغان او پښتني دود کې، د وخت پېژندل او د هغې ښه ګټه اخیستل ډېر مهم دي، چې له دې کبله دا نوم روحاني ارزښت لري.

in_english.name: Avan
in_english.long_meaning: The name Avan originates from the Arabic root 'أَوَنَ', meaning suitable time or moment. In Islamic tradition, the concept of time and choosing the right moment for actions is significant. The name Avan, therefore, carries spiritual importance, emphasizing the value of timing and appropriateness in life. Historically, the term has been used in various contexts within Islamic literature and culture, reflecting its enduring relevance.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Avan" may have a significant cultural impact in various Islamic communities. The name is derived from the Persian language and carries historical and cultural significance as Persia was an important civilization and cultural cradle in Islamic history. As Persian language and culture greatly influenced Islamic art, literature, and thought, having a Persian name like "Avan" could be seen as an expression of Islamic diversity and multiculturalism. It could also serve as a reminder of the rich Islamic heritage rooted in Persian history and culture.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Avan" is often associated with the concept of spiritual freedom and breath - the breath of life given by Allah. In Islam, everything that exists is from Allah, including the breaths we take to live. The name "Avan" may serve as a reminder of the spiritual freedom believers have been granted by Allah. It may also encourage individuals to breathe deeply and remember the presence of Allah in their lives. Additionally, Islamic tradition teaches that Allah is the breathe (Ruh) that keeps the believer alive in both this world and the next. Therefore, having a name like "Avan," meaning breath or wind, may serve as a spiritual reminder of Allah's divine presence and power in one's life.
